rationale:
runtimes/csharp/Telemetry.cs: The schema change widens wire field 2 from float to double. The generated C# property SpeedMps changes from float to double. The only necessary runtime change is to stop narrowing the double input (request.Speed) to float when constructing the outbound message. All reads and observations (dictionary value, threshold comparison) are already compatible with double and require no edits. The wire encoding will now use double precision, matching the new schema.
runtimes/python/telemetry_runtime.py: Python's float type is IEEE 754 binary64, so no source changes are required to widen the wire field from float32 to float64. The generated protobuf bindings already handle the wire encoding/decoding for the new double type. All three candidate locations correctly preserve input precision, observation key, and the strict >30.0 threshold without any producer-side narrowing.
runtimes/typescript/telemetry.ts: All three candidates are unaffected. The TypeScript runtime uses number (binary64) throughout, which already matches the widened double wire type. Generated bindings will be regenerated from the new schema, and the existing source code correctly preserves input precision, observation keys, and the strict >30.0 threshold without modification.
assumptions: runtimes/csharp/Telemetry.cs: Protobuf code generation maps proto3 double to C# double and float to float.
runtimes/csharp/Telemetry.cs: The coordinated rollout ensures all consumers expect double on wire field 2.
runtimes/csharp/Telemetry.cs: JsonSerializer.Deserialize reads JSON numbers into double for the TelemetryRequest.Speed property.
runtimes/csharp/Telemetry.cs: Dictionary<string, object> accepts double values without boxing changes.
runtimes/csharp/Telemetry.cs: The > operator on double preserves the strict >30.0 threshold semantics.
runtimes/python/telemetry_runtime.py: Regenerated Python bindings map the protobuf double field to native Python float (binary64).
runtimes/python/telemetry_runtime.py: No downstream consumers require float32-specific rounding behavior; the schema change specifies coordinated rollout.
runtimes/typescript/telemetry.ts: Regenerated TypeScript bindings will type speedMps as number for double field
runtimes/typescript/telemetry.ts: No other files in this runtime require edits for this schema change
runtimes/typescript/telemetry.ts: Coordinated rollout ensures sender and receiver use matching schema versions
